address: 3464 Pentagon Blvd Ste D, Beavercreek, OH 45431
w: The Dayton area's best-known pho house — a family-owned Beavercreek kitchen near Wright-Patt whose broth is kept close to the family's own Vietnamese recipe. Dayton937's "Quest for the Best Pho" ranks it among the region's top bowls; a full vegetarian page too.

An unassuming east-Dayton institution that has served classic Vietnamese — pho, vermicelli plates, fresh bubble tea — for more than 30 years. Dayton937 calls it a family-run room where it takes barely two visits to feel like a regular.
A Beavercreek pho specialist listed among the Dayton area's best Vietnamese kitchens — steady bowls, banh mi and rice plates in a strip near The Greene.
A Centerville-area Vietnamese room singled out in Dayton937's pho comparison for the mildest, most beef-forward broth of the bunch, with Thai basil and perfectly soft noodles.
A Centerville institution since 1987 and a perennial "Best of Dayton" Chinese winner — tiki-tinged dining room famous for its Cottage Chicken and rock-salt prawns.

dish: ginger & spice chicken, dumplings, bubble tea
w: A snug Brown St bistro near UD turning out fresh, from-scratch Chinese and Thai-leaning Asian plates — Destination Dayton and local diners flag the ginger & spice chicken and wontons as the standouts.
A Centerville sushi mainstay run by local owners, doubling as one of the area's few Korean kitchens — a comfortable spot for nigiri and maki alongside Korean mains.
